in_marathi.name: Keshto
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keshto हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Keshto is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kesh’, which means hair. The name is believed to be a symbol of honor, glory, and power. It is mentioned in Hindu scriptures as the name of a king or a warrior. Keshto is a powerful and majestic name, suitable for a baby boy.
